SELECT r.run_id, r.instance_name, r.roles, r.worker_groups, r.status, r.started_at, r.heartbeat_at, r.stopped_at, s.state_value AS telemetry FROM ifj_app_run r LEFT JOIN ifj_cluster_state s ON s.state_key =
r.status IN ('STOPPED', 'CRASHED')
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ifj_app_run newer WHERE newer.instance_name = r.instance_name AND (newer.started_at > r.started_at OR (newer.started_at = r.started_at AND newer.run_id > r.run_id)))
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, r.run_id DESC

SELECT execution.status, AS count FROM ifj_instance execution WHERE GROUP BY execution.status
SELECT status, AS count FROM ifj_instance WHERE parent_instance_id IS NULL AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'WAITING_EVENT') GROUP BY status

SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait wait_record WHERE wait_record.wait_type = 'APPROVAL' AND wait_record.status = 'WAITING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifj_event_wait_operator wait_operator WHERE wait_operator.wait_id = wait_record.id AND wait_operator.operator_id = #{operatorId} )

SELECT execution.id, execution.target_id, execution.target_type, CASE WHEN execution.target_type = 'TASK' THEN task_snapshot.name WHEN execution.target_type = 'JOB' THEN job_snapshot.name ELSE NULL END AS name, execution.status, execution.create_time, execution.end_time FROM ifj_instance execution LEFT JOIN ifj_task_definition task_snapshot ON task_snapshot.id = execution.task_definition_id LEFT JOIN ifj_job_definition job_snapshot ON job_snapshot.id = execution.definition_id WHERE AND execution.status IN ('FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT') ORDER BY execution.create_time DESC, execution.id DESC
